The '''Grim Path''' was a roadway located in the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Grim Path appears as an area on Hoth in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
